resources.string: Enter physical quantities for the products you counted. Blank fields are skipped; enter 0 for none. Expected stock is captured when this count opens.
Add active products before starting a count.
Enter a recorder and at least one physical quantity from 0 to 1,000,000. Explain any variance in the notes.
Counted products: %1$d. Products with a variance: %2$d. Confirming updates stock to the entered physical quantities and keeps a permanent count record. Blank fields remain unchanged.
